semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Univertical Corporation provides high-quality plating materials and chemicals that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Univertical Corporation specializes in manufacturing high-quality Copper and Nickel anodes and chemicals, which are crucial for the plating processes in semiconductor manufacturing. Their extensive product line includes Copper Sulfate, Nickel Sulfate, and various specialty anodes, supporting the semiconductor industry's demand for reliable and high-purity materials.
capabilities: Manufacturing of fine grain Copper anodes
Production of high-purity Copper Sulfate and Nickel Sulfate
Specialty anodes including Tin, Zinc, Solder, and Brass
Cyanide products including Sodium and Potassium Cyanides
